The higher-value optionality is ACACIA-HCM (non-obstructive HCM, both primary endpoints met Q1 2026, roughly doubling the addressable HCM population), but management has not disclosed an sNDA filing/PDUFA date, so it fails the DATED test today. Net: a legitimate dated forward binary exists but the asymmetry is thin; WATCH, revisit if/when an ACACIA-HCM (nHCM) sNDA acceptance and PDUFA date are announced.
